The *Uddālakapupphiyattheraapadāna* is a verse narrative belonging to the *Therāpadāna* collection of the late canonical Pali literature [SuttaCentral]. The title indicates that it records the biographical and karmic narrative (*apadāna*) of a senior monk (*thera*) whose past pious deed was an offering of *uddālaka* flowers (*uddālakapupphiya*). SuttaCentral records five modern translations across five languages for this text [SuttaCentral].
